_comment: ADR-021 research/review watch-list. `labctl research` re-synthesises current AI best-practice research (via RESYNTH) and diffs the candidate against these watch items to detect when a current SubstrateOS choice ages out, surfacing a human-promoted review report (never auto-merged). The public Base ships this default list; an Overlay may extend or replace it.

items.name: instruction compile formats
items.why: SKILL.md / AGENTS.md and the per-engine instruction files are the write-once compile targets (ADR-019); if the ecosystem standard shifts, the compiler must follow or the Base ages out.

items.name: supported conversational engines
items.why: The engine-agnostic front-end targets a fixed adapter set; new frontier engines or deprecations change the adapter table (labctl/engines.py).

items.name: in-container execution engine
items.why: Bespoke capsule execution vs an external agent runtime (e.g. OpenHands) is a named contingency to switch on a signal.

items.name: dynamic-workflow / ultracode surface
items.why: Claude Code's ultracode / Dynamic-Workflows feature surface is the explicit watch item for ADR-027's deferred escalation hatch.
items.current_choice: OS-native orchestrate.py (architect -> workers -> reviewer -> judge); ultracode not integrated

items.name: default model
items.why: The default conversational / judge model tier; reassessed as frontier models change.

items.name: memory retrieval
items.why: Keyword BM25 vs vector/hybrid retrieval; hybrid stays deferred behind MemoryProvider until a quality need or hardware is shown.

items.name: governing research
items.why: The master research document itself is the RESYNTH output; this item tracks its currency against the live frontier.
